data.description: HC-0 finding, 2026-09-27 18:4x, the client's ruling on the deployed drive: "guest view should have stats for answers". Today SPEC §5 gives the buzzer 'Room code only' at split and work, and the counts live only on the wall (five bars, n · p%, 'N of M in the room answered'). Build: from split on (split, work, reveal), the buzzer shows the same per-letter counts the wall shows, in the wall's order and shape (letter, count, percent; the reader's own letter marked as theirs, no ✗ ever, AC-94; colour never the only signal, AC-40; at reveal the ✓ letter marked as on the wall). The counts ride the buzzer payload as a new optional field filled server-side from the same totals the wall uses (sealed::buzzer or view.rs — whichever the wall's projection uses, so wall and phone can never disagree; a test asserts they agree, as §4.5 does for the most-chosen option); absent before split. Nothing per-participant leaves the server (AC-58 stays: the reader's own letter is known client-side). Canary: extend the payload-shape assertions so the new field is allowed only from split on and carries letters, counts and percents only; pre-reveal option objects stay {letter, text}; all plants still absent. Copy: whatever labels the wall's bars use, reused (no new sentence unless the client gives one). SPEC §5 split/work/reveal buzzer cells and the prototype's buzzer at those phases are amended in the same PR under the PQ-34 ruled exception; DESIGN.md is not edited — F-29 routed upstream. Prototype visual for the bars on a phone: the wall's bars scaled to the phone column; the client reviews a screenshot in the tab before the PR. Inline-full: plan review and code review subagents. Dispatch after the HC-0 drive ends; PQ-36 (copy round two) and this ticket both touch web/buzzer and copy.js, so PQ-36 lands first and this one branches from it or merges it.
